description:
Role: UI Developer 
 Location: Charlotte, NC
 Duration: Long term
 Job Description: 

 The persons would be involved in designing, developing, configuring and maintaining web applications hosted as standalone applications or in a Portal environment. The desired candidate must possess the following qualifications and skills:  
 • Must have at least 5 years of programming experience with UI technologies 
 • Must have excellent communications 
 • Must be a team player 
 • Strong UI and Scripting experience with HTML, CSS, JavaScript / JavaScript frameworks 
 • Understand the importance of User Interface and User experience from a Web perspective 
 • Hands-on experience writing UI Unit tests 
 • Understanding of Web technologies 
 • Experience with Agile Scrum methodologies 
 • Some Programming experience with JAVA technologies 
 • Basic SQL with Hands-on experience with any one RDBMS 
 • Have used JIRA / Wiki and other collaboration tools in a team environment 
 • Knowledge of Continuous Integration 
 • Knowledge of Code Quality Management tools 
 • Knowledge of SSO 
 • Understanding of Web/App Servers like Apache HTTPD and Apache Tomcat would be a plus 
 • Liferay portal experience would be a plus.
 



 
 Thanks & Regards,
